_doc: #1774 Cloud Store > Search > Phone > Play Integrity: which Play Integrity verdict tier a Google Play app is known to require. Served at runtime as shared/store-play-integrity (same framework as store-phone-recommendations, #1749), never baked into an APK. `tiers` are the verdict levels in ascending strictness plus `unknown`; each app carries `tier`, `basis` (publisher-documented | reported | unverified) and a `note`. `unknown` is the honest answer wherever the tier is not known: it is never rounded to a tier, and an app not listed here shows as unknown. Add or correct a row to change a verdict; no Kotlin. The Store removes every constellation-fleet package at runtime.

tiers.label: Basic
tiers.meaning: Runs on a device that passes only the basic system-integrity check (may be rooted or unlocked-bootloader, but not obviously tampered).

tiers.label: Device
tiers.meaning: Needs a genuine, Play-certified Android device with a locked, uncompromised system.

tiers.label: Strong
tiers.meaning: Needs a hardware-backed verdict: certified device, locked bootloader and a recent security patch.

tiers.label: Unknown
tiers.meaning: No evidence of which tier the app requires. Never rounded to a tier.
